             operative on the HYD SD page.
             Note:      Simultaneous illumination of the BLUE ELEC PUMP pb-sw FAULT light and the

                        oil low pressure switch. In this case, the ENG 1(2) OIL LO PR alert is inoperative

      ‐ PTU pb-sw ............................................................................................................................. OFF

                  CONFIG NORMAL” line will not replace the "T.O CONFIG . . TEST" line in the T.O

                  T.O CONFIG TEST except a false HYD G(Y) ENG 1(2) PUMP LO PR alert.

29-23-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      No restrictions.
   FLIGHT CREW

   AFTER ENGINE START
      Check of the PTU operation:
      ‐ GREEN ENG 1 PUMP pb-sw ................................................................................................OFF
      ‐ On the HYD SD page, check that the green system pressure is correct.
        A correct pressure is 3 000 PSI (± 200 PSI).
      ‐ GREEN ENG 1 PUMP pb-sw .................................................................................................. On
      ‐ YELLOW ENG 2 PUMP pb-sw ............................................................................................. OFF
      ‐ YELLOW ELEC PUMP pb-sw ................................................................................................. Off
      ‐ On the HYD SD page, check that the yellow system pressure is correct.
        A correct pressure is 3 000 PSI (± 200 PSI).
      ‐ YELLOW ENG 2 PUMP pb-sw ................................................................................................On
      Note:      1. The PTU pressurizes the system to a nominal value of 3 000 PSI (± 200 PSI), but if
                    no consumers are operated the pressure is not constant. The PTU operates in a cycle
                    which keeps the pressure in the hydraulic systems between 2 100 PSI and 3 200 PSI.
                 2. For passengers comfort, the PTU may be set to OFF during the taxi after landing
                    provided that both engines hydraulic pumps are operative and running. The PTU must
                    be set back to AUTO before leaving the aircraft.
29-23-01A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
제한 없음.
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
AFTER ENGINE START (엔진 시동 후)
PTU 작동 점검:
- GREEN ENG 1 PUMP pb-sw ...... OFF
- HYD SD page에서 green system 압력이 정상인지 확인한다.
정상 압력은 3 000 PSI (± 200 PSI)이다.
- GREEN ENG 1 PUMP pb-sw ...... On
- YELLOW ENG 2 PUMP pb-sw ...... OFF
- YELLOW ELEC PUMP pb-sw ...... Off
- HYD SD page에서 yellow system 압력이 정상인지 확인한다.
정상 압력은 3 000 PSI (± 200 PSI)이다.
- YELLOW ENG 2 PUMP pb-sw ...... On
Note: 1. PTU는 계통을 공칭값 3 000 PSI (± 200 PSI)로 가압하지만, 유압 사용 장치(consumer)를 작동하지 않으면 압력이 일정하지 않다. PTU는 유압 계통 압력을 2 100 PSI와 3 200 PSI 사이로 유지하는 주기(cycle)로 작동한다.
2. 승객 쾌적성을 위해, 양쪽 engine hydraulic pump가 모두 작동하며 돌아가고 있는 조건이면 착륙 후 택시 중 PTU를 OFF로 놓을 수 있다. 항공기를 떠나기 전에 PTU를 반드시 AUTO로 되돌려 놓아야 한다.

pump가 계속 작동하고 off로 놓아도 멈추지 않는 경우:
DOORS/CARGO (122 VU의 T12) C/B ..... Pull
